name: Customaise
description: The bridge between Claude Desktop and your Customaise Chrome extension. Claude reads live pages, calls custom WebMCP tools, writes UserScripts and AgentScripts, all in your signed-in browser session.
long_description:
Customaise is the layer between any site and any AI agent. It runs two kinds of small scripts in your browser. UserScripts reshape the pages you live in: the standard .user.js userscript format, plus an AI editor that writes them from a single sentence. AgentScripts go the other direction: they expose a site as custom WebMCP tools your agent can call. Build them yourself, install them from the community, or have Claude write them for you.

This bundle is the bridge between Claude Desktop and the Customaise Chrome extension. Once installed, Claude can call the custom WebMCP tools registered on your open tabs (through Customaise's human-in-the-loop consent gate), read live page DOM, take screenshots, capture console output, and write or edit UserScripts and AgentScripts on your behalf. Everything runs in the browser session where you're already signed in: no API keys, no service accounts, no separate OAuth. The same 19 tools work for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf, Antigravity, and Kiro through their own MCP configurations.

You need the Customaise Chrome extension installed and signed in. The extension is the full product; a Power User plan unlocks unlimited use of this MCP bridge.
